source_material.description: Raw FORGE Trusted Knowledge Freshness & Continuous Reverification overview, scope/plan, primary goal, and current-status checkpoint supplied for public artifact packaging on 2026-09-15.
Authoritative FORGE public manifest supplied in the same packaging session and used for ID allocation and deduplication.

directly_recorded_facts: The existing supersession/versioning system can be reused.
The design names six freshness classes: static, slow, volatile, highly_volatile, event_driven, and manual.
Freshness policy is intended to live in brain_config / Admin rather than hard-coded intervals.
The next implementation step is freshness policy plus scheduler/queueing worker.

derived_values.name: freshness_classes_defined
derived_values.formula: count(static, slow, volatile, highly_volatile, event_driven, manual)

interpretations: The freshness lifecycle is materially distinct from existing public artifacts focused on initial acquisition, promotion, release, indexing, and retrieval because its primary concern is post-promotion validity over time.
The current source supports publication of the architecture/foundation but not a verified claim that continuous reverification is operational end to end.
